name: sessionz
description: Adds /tabs: a live pane listing every Claude Code session with its status and folder. Press a row to bring that session's terminal tab to the front (Ghostty, iTerm2, Terminal, tmux, VS Code).

autoName.title: Name unnamed sessions with Haiku
autoName.description: Give a session with no name a short name from Haiku after its first real prompt, so its tab title and the /tabs list show what it is about.
